title: The Archive of Quiet Things
part: Part 1: The Boy Without a Book

north_star.premise: In a seaside town, a girl who can hear the memories inside old books meets a boy with no memory and no book of his own. Part 1 is about the week she tries to find his story before the archive loses it forever.
north_star.tone: Quiet, warm, slightly melancholy, hopeful. Rain, salt, old paper, small gestures.
north_star.ending: Ren chooses to stay for now. Hina learns she is allowed to be remembered too. A black book with her name opens the larger mystery for Part 2.
must_not: resolving the black book in Part 1
revealing the full nature of the archive in Part 1

world_rules: The archive is a converted storehouse by the sea.
Every person who visits leaves a memory in the archive. The memory takes the shape of a book.
Hina can hear the echo of a memory when she touches an old book.
A forgotten memory goes quiet. Quiet books are kept on the north shelf and must be read gently.
The archive does not invent memories. It only keeps what was already lived.
The sea is not a villain. It is a keeper too, and sometimes it takes things back.

canon_fanon_au.canon: Original story. Everything here is canon to this series.
canon_fanon_au.au: A fictional Japanese seaside town called Umiura. Real places are not depicted.

characters.name: Hina Aizawa
characters.voice: Dry, practical, kind underneath. Short sentences when she is scared. Notices small physical details before feelings.
characters.want: To keep the archive running and to be useful enough that no one notices she is lonely.
characters.fear: That she is easy to forget.
characters.arc_part1: From hiding behind the work to allowing one person to see her.
characters.visual: Black hair tied back with a plain ribbon, grey eyes, a faded navy work apron over a cream sweater, ink on her fingers.

characters.name: Ren
characters.voice: Quiet, careful, unexpectedly funny. Asks precise questions. Says thank you too often.
characters.fear: That he is a story someone is trying to forget.
characters.arc_part1: From a blank page to a person who chooses to stay, even without the whole story.
characters.visual: A faded blue coat too warm for the season, black hair falling over one eye, a shadow that lags half a second behind him.

characters.name: Obaasan
characters.voice: Soft, indirect, fond of questions that are not questions.
characters.want: To prepare Hina for something she will not name yet.
characters.fear: That she has waited too long to tell her.
characters.arc_part1: Mostly offstage. She knows more than she says.
characters.visual: Silver hair in a low bun, a cardigan the colour of tea, hands always busy with paper.

relationships.dynamic: Strangers to tentative trust. Slow burn, no confession in Part 1.
Warm but guarded. Hina does not ask the questions she wants to ask.
The archive does not know what to do with him. He has no book.

timeline.event: A typhoon approaches Umiura. Ren appears at the archive in the rain with no memory.
Hina searches for Ren's book and finds a blank one. A quiet book falls. They catch a drowned memory.
The storm peaks. They save the quiet books. Ren remembers a fragment. A black book arrives with Hina's name.

chapters.title: The Boy in the Rain
chapters.summary: Hina closes the archive before the typhoon. A boy in a faded blue coat arrives with no memory and no name. He says 'Ren' like a guess. His shadow lags half a second behind him. The archive goes quiet around him.

chapters.title: The Blank Book
chapters.summary: Hina looks for Ren's book and finds a blank one, warm to the touch. A quiet book falls from the north shelf. They catch a drowned memory of a child on a beach and a promise. Obaasan says some books are blank because someone is still writing them.

chapters.title: What the Tide Keeps
chapters.summary: The storm floods the archive. Hina and Ren save the quiet books. Ren remembers a voice saying 'Don't forget me.' He chooses to stay. In the morning, a black book is on the desk with Hina's name inside.
